name: FlipFilterGrid
job: Filter chips that sort a set of cards by category while the cards glide to their new places instead of jumping
visitor_action: click/tap one or more chips; Esc clears
motion: cards translate to new positions with spring, hidden ones shrink and fade (reduced-motion: instant filter)
art_direction: Editorial magazine index: paper #F4F0E7, ink #16140F, one vermilion accent #C2381B; Fraunces serif titles (featured item in large light italic) + JetBrains Mono meta; text-only index chips with accent underline, borderless photos, no cards or ground decoration
